channel.title: media-curator - reads
channel.description: Weekly reading picks, as short recaps to skim and dive into.

item.title: Project Pilot: Can AI control a drone?
item.description: Published failure data rather than a capability victory lap: the frontier model beats baseline on four of five sub-tasks and still flies into a wall it mistook for a doorway. - ~8 min read (estimated)

item.title: A global workspace in language models
item.description: A direct successor to earlier interpretability research on introspection: describes an internal workspace holding thoughts that never reach the model's output. - ~10 min read (estimated)
